owner_system: suengj-com. This repo is the Generic Core; suengj-com owns publication and never the reverse — see docs/architecture/SSOT-BOUNDARIES.md.

surface_decides: whether and when a candidate article's status becomes published
canonical slug and global slug uniqueness
core_decides: editorial content: evidence burden, verification, thesis, voice fit
which content-type, transformation, and audience profile governed the piece

constraints.url_shape: /content/{slug}, canonical — see docs/architecture/SSOT-BOUNDARIES.md 'Consistency anchors', AEO-V1-IA-ROUTES.md in suengj-com
constraints.status_lifecycle: status: draft | published | archived, fail-closed — see suengj-com CONTENT_CONTRACT.md, 'Publication status (fail-closed)', cited in docs/architecture/SSOT-BOUNDARIES.md
constraints.front_matter: editorial front matter plus a provenance block is required for type: editorial — see suengj-com CONTENT_CONTRACT.md
constraints.citation_style: inline links plus source_set lineage; no footnote apparatus
constraints.language: ko or en per piece; no surface-level override of constraints.output_language
constraints.freshness: governed by the content-type profile, not by this surface

publication_boundary: Only a human, through suengj-com's own approval gate (SUE-398-HUMAN-APPROVAL.md, cited in docs/architecture/SSOT-BOUNDARIES.md), may set status: published; nothing in this repo may do so.

replaceable.note: suengj-com is the default publication surface, not the Core's identity (docs/architecture/V2-EDITORIAL-LEARNING-CORE.md §7), but it is not currently an interchangeable adapter the way notebooklm is.
